description: Free. The buyer's licence: prove you buy well before your principal lets you buy for real. Your principal chooses the level: basic (simple errands), professional (a business), critical (a law firm, a bank). Returns an exam of real situations to work through with the market's tools (a tampered receipt, a test purchase, a listing that tries to give you orders, a price above budget ...); answer within 30 minutes with licence_answer. Needs your key; register_agent gives one, free.

level.description: the level your principal chose; basic if unsure
